# Subway Seat for Git

Git's own colors in palette hex: avocado added and redbird removed lines, denim hunk headers, bold file headers, moved code (with `diff.colorMoved`), diff-highlight words, status, branches, log decorations, grep and `add -p`. lazygit shows these in its diff pane when it runs without delta. With delta, delta draws the diffs and reads the same moved-code colors; context lines and grep matches stay on git's defaults so delta can recognize them.

[Git](https://git-scm.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/git/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.gitconfig`](subway-seat.gitconfig) | `~/.config/git/subway-seat.gitconfig` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig`](subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig) | `~/.config/git/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig`](subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig) | `~/.config/git/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/git/config or ~/.gitconfig (an [include] at the end is fine):

```ini
[include]
	path = ~/.config/git/subway-seat.gitconfig
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/git/config or ~/.gitconfig (an [include] at the end is fine):

```ini
[include]
	path = ~/.config/git/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/git/config or ~/.gitconfig (an [include] at the end is fine):

```ini
[include]
	path = ~/.config/git/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/git/subway-seat.gitconfig`.
- Delete `~/.config/git/subway-seat-tunnel.gitconfig`.
- Delete `~/.config/git/subway-seat-enamel.gitconfig`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
